name: bash

input.command:
PORT=3001 node .output/server/index.mjs &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 1.5
ORDER_RESP=$(curl -s -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"lines": [{"slug": "notebook", "qty": 2}]}' http://localhost:3001/api/orders)
echo "POST response: $ORDER_RESP"
ORDER_ID=$(echo $ORDER_RESP | grep -o '"id":"[^"]*' | cut -d'"' -f4)
echo "Generated Order ID: $ORDER_ID"
HTML_RESP=$(curl -s http://localhost:3001/orders/$ORDER_ID)
echo "--- HTML RENDER RESULT ---"
echo "$HTML_RESP" | grep -E "order-line|order-total"
echo "--------------------------"
kill $SERVER_PID
